facts.text: Evan mentioned he is being extra careful with his health and is trying to eat less processed food and sugary snacks, even though he loves ginger snaps.

evidence.quote: I'm being extra careful with my health lately. I'm trying to eat less processed food and sugary snacks, even though I love ginger snaps.

facts.text: Sam stated he has not made any changes to his diet and still enjoys soda and candy, although he acknowledges it's not the best habit.

evidence.quote: Nah, no changes for me. Still enjoying my soda and candy, although I know it's not the best habit to have.

facts.text: Evan suggested that Sam consider swapping soda for flavored seltzer water and replacing candy with dark chocolate with high cocoa content as healthier alternatives.

evidence.quote: Have you considered swapping soda for flavored seltzer water? It's still bubbly and tasty, but without the sugar. And instead of candy, you could try dark chocolate with high cocoa content - it's a healthier option.

facts.text: Sam responded positively to Evan's suggestion and indicated he would try the healthier alternatives.

evidence.quote: Yeah, good idea! I'll give it a try.
